name: @skal/cli
description: Skal CLI — create and run Skal apps anywhere on disk, no monorepo clone needed.
_engines_note: Tracks vite 8's own floor (^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0) — the generated project's build/dev scripts invoke vite directly, so a Node the CLI accepts but vite rejects fails at `skal build`, not at install. This said >=18, and every generated build failed under Node 18.
